---
name: Task card
about: A work package for one agent or contributor

labels: task
---

**Goal**
<!-- One or two sentences: what is done when this card is finished. -->

**Lane**
<!-- e.g. A audio engine, C skin and gfx, G plugin host, M0 foundation -->

**Owned paths**
<!-- Crates or files this card may change, e.g. crates/rustamp-playlist/ -->

**Allowed sources**
<!-- Specs (specs/S-xx-*.md) and free sources (e.g. webamp, DeaDBeeF, butterchurn). Never dirty sources. -->

**Spec dependencies**
<!-- Spec IDs this card depends on, and their status. -->

**Interface contract**
<!-- Traits, types or protocol messages this card implements or consumes. Link the RFC if the contract changes. -->

**Acceptance tests**
- [ ] <!-- e.g. unit tests for X pass -->
- [ ] <!-- e.g. golden case Y matches -->

**Provenance notes**
<!-- Which free sources are used, and any third-party code to be copied (source, license, attribution). -->
